title: Dxcufgb's dice trails
description: Gives Dice So Nice dice a streak of their damage type while they roll: a tail of fire, a jagged lightning bolt, frost, death-smoke and more. Design your own trails for attacks, checks, saves, initiative and other rolls: 76 designs (Flame, Frost, Storm, Comet, Rainbow, Knives, one for each D&D class, species and background, ...) with several styles each, stack them, use your own images, and everyone sees them on your rolls.

requires.reason: The trails are drawn on Dice So Nice's 3D dice.
